summary: Declare check mode with supports_check_mode=True and check module.check_mode to avoid changes; otherwise check-mode runs are skipped with a 'does not support check mode' message.
questions: How do I add check mode support to my module?
Why does my module get skipped in check mode?
How does a module know it's running in check mode?

answer_card.title: Declare check mode support
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
if module.check_mode:
    ...  # make no changes
```
With the default `supports_check_mode=False`, the module exits in check mode with `skipped=True` and `remote module (<name>) does not support check mode`.
